chars.W: WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 28, long dark wavy hair worn loose, mustard-yellow silk blouse, black pencil skirt, small gold hoop earrings.
chars.H: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 32, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, light-blue button shirt with rolled sleeves, dark navy chinos.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern Casablanca apartment living room in the evening. The WIFE, seen head-to-waist from the doorway, stands at the dining table and firmly puts her office ID badge on a lanyard down on the table, pushing it away, a determined little smile, face clearly visible. Flat 2D animated illustration.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Bright modern office in Casablanca. The WIFE sits at her desk with a laptop and folders, working, looking busy and professional. Head-to-waist framing, face visible. Flat 2D animated illustration.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Cosy Moroccan living room with a traditional sedari sofa and a tea tray. The WIFE sits relaxed on the sofa with her legs tucked, smiling, telling her HUSBAND something; the HUSBAND stands in front of her with raised eyebrows, surprised. Both faces visible. Flat 2D animated illustration.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. The WIFE holds her HUSBAND's hands while sitting next to him on the sofa, explaining calmly and sweetly, tilting her head; the HUSBAND listens, half convinced. Both faces visible. Flat 2D animated illustration.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, Moroccan apartment. In the foreground the HUSBAND stands by the balcony window, arms crossed, looking back over his shoulder with a doubtful, thoughtful frown. In the background inside the living room the WIFE lies relaxed on the sofa, smiling at her phone screen (screen not visible). Both faces visible. Flat 2D animated illustration.
